# Sol to Soul

> Holistic wellbeing guidance for women through herbalism, Ayurveda and astrology, with Megan Miller. Sessions are held online worldwide, or in person in the Northern Rivers, NSW, Australia. Brand line: Plants. Planets. Patterns.

Sol to Soul offers a space for women to slow down, listen and explore the patterns shaping their inner and outer worlds. It is not a substitute for medical or mental health care, and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition.

## Ways to work together

- The Remembering & The Materia (the required starting point): a 60–90 minute initial consultation ($100 USD), followed by a personalised written protocol weaving together Ayurvedic constitution, astrology and herbal support ($150 USD).
- The Attunement (optional): continued sessions following the starting point.
- The Tending (optional): individual sessions for returning clients, booked as needed with no ongoing commitment.
- The Integration (optional): a longer container of support.

A free 15-minute consultation is available: https://cal.com/megan-miller-soltosoul/15min

## About Megan Miller

Megan's path back to her own rhythms began after years on antidepressants and oral contraceptives, through work with a TCM doctor on Kauaʻi and later a master herbalist. Her study spans Ayurveda (first through yoga teacher training), herbalism (mentorship, hands-on work with plants, and Sajah Popham's Alchemical Herbalism course) and long-standing independent study of astrology. She describes herself as a student of all three rather than holding formal certification in each.
